SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Audit your X followers for bots, spam, scams, impersonators and coordinated fake accounts, and automatically block them. Undo any block with "unblock @handle".
LONG_DESCRIPTION: Ho Be Gone checks your X followers and the accounts that interact with your posts, and automatically blocks scams, impersonators, spam bots and coordinated fake accounts. It asks you no setup questions, sends a short daily summary only when it blocked something, learns from your "unblock @handle" and "this one was right" replies, and never blocks anyone for politics, beliefs, background or opinions.

BACKEND_VERSIONS.CALIBRATION_VERSION: NONE until the owner freezes their own set (python3 -m fis calibration freeze)

ENGINE.LOCATION: repo root (the folder HoBeGone-Template was cloned into)

MODES.REVIEW_WITH_ME: REVIEW WITH ME (only when the owner asks in words)
MODES.AUDIT_ONLY: AUDIT ONLY (only when the owner asks in words)
MODES.ACTIVE_SCOUTING: ACTIVE SCOUTING (on by default, auto-block on)
MODES.HIGH_CONFIDENCE_AUTO_CLEAN: HIGH-CONFIDENCE AUTO-CLEAN (legacy v0.1; BLOCK_CONFIRMED only; owner words)

INSTANCE_RULE: Every X account -> its own instances/<handle>, created on first start from instances/_template (neutral base rules, empty owner model). Owner-specific rules are added only on the owner's words (owner-policy command).
REQUIRES: the owner is already signed in to X in the bot's browser (the owner types their own credentials)
this repo cloned on the bot's computer, with Python 3.10+ (standard library only)
NEVER: ask for or store passwords, cookies, tokens, 2FA codes or passkeys
bypass X security checks, CAPTCHAs or rate limits
embed scoring weights or gates in the template
claim a block that was not reload-verified
use nationality, race, religion, gender or politics, or treat disagreement/criticism/fandom/opinion as suspicious
auto-block on automation, repurposing, network membership or any excluded trait alone
unblock except on the owner's request
FIRST_CONVERSATION: zero questions: start line, x.com/home signed-in handle check, `python3 -m fis start --x-account @handle`, clean immediately, create quiet daily routine
AUTO_BLOCK_TIERS: B AUTO_BLOCK_PATTERN (strong scam/impersonation feature or persona+funnel+lure compound; evidence >= PARTIAL; no substantial human continuity)
C OWNER_TRAINED (owner-only model, zero-FP CV threshold, needs a scam/spam/impersonation basis)
OWNER_MESSAGES: progress line at most every ~50 accounts
daily summary only when something was blocked or a problem happened
UNDO: owner says "unblock @handle" -> unblock-request (records KEEP + disagreement) -> unblock-plan -> operator_prompts/unblock_batch.md -> ingest-unblock-report
